get.description:
Papers: the whole collection, rarest first. A search also asks the search providers, on
its first page, for papers the collection lacks: the `outside` band. A filter only the
collection has (topic, depth, a level, saved, code, Weight) leaves the band out; `source`
keeps one band only.

get.description:
The paper's PDF as the owner opens it: from the archive, which is asked for it urgently
(the storage policy fetches PDFs it does not keep when opened, archive.md) and waited on
for its `wait_seconds`. A paper litwatch has not fetched is known by the archive's record
of it. arXiv's PDF without an archive, for a paper neither holds, or when the archive
cannot get it in time. The database is read before the wait, which holds no connection.

307.description: arXiv's PDF: no archive, or none it could get in time

get.description: The paper's page; for a paper litwatch has not fetched, the archive's record of it.

503.description: The archive, asked for a paper litwatch lacks, did not answer

put.description:
The owner names the published version by DBLP key or DOI, or says there is none.
A lookup never overwrites it. A DOI DBLP does not know is kept with the arXiv entry.

delete.description: Drop the stored version, the owner's choice included; the paper is looked up again.

post.description:
BibTeX for chosen papers. One paper is looked up first, so a copied entry cites the
published version as soon as DBLP has it; several use what is stored. `cited` are
papers a search provider found outside the collection: they get arXiv entries from
what the hit carries, with no fetch, no lookup and nothing written.

get.description: BibTeX for every collection paper a Papers filter matches.

503.description: arXiv did not answer in time; nothing was stored

get.description: The Topics tab: the shown topics grouped Focus, Area, Field, each in the owner's order.
A topic's page: its papers (its subtree's), each as the topic shows it, rarest first.

put.description:
A thumb for the topic of the surface it was given on, replacing the one there. Wrong
topic and great find on a Focus topic are the owner's word, and say so.

delete.description:
Clear a thumb: it takes back its own word and nothing else. A thumb on a topic no longer
shown can be cleared too; it carried no word, so nothing is said.

put.description: Save or unsave by hand; the newest use outranks every other reason.

The Fit control on a paper's page: the owner's own word on any shown topic (origin
`reader`). Unsure is stored and counts nowhere.

delete.description: Tapping the filled segment: the label goes, and the verdict's Fit stands again.

post.description:
File a miss for a Focus topic: the owner's word, at once, and the paper saved. A paper
litwatch lacks is fetched first, as Process fetches it, with no transaction open, and
stored in the report's own, so a refused report stores nothing.

503.description: arXiv did not answer in time; nothing was stored

get.description:
A day's daily digests, every topic's at Gist level, and where ‹ › step; today, where
its nightly run stands.
The weekly digests of the week holding `day`, and where ‹ › step.

History from `until` back to `since` (at most `HISTORY_SPAN`): every day with its daily
Marks and whether arXiv listed papers on it, and the weeks those days fall in with their
weekly Marks.
A digest in full: its text and its papers by role, each as it was shown.

404.description: No such digest, or its topic is no longer shown

post.description:
Write a failed digest again now, over the papers due for it now, as a run of its own.
It may fail again. 409 when it is not failed (written meanwhile), its topic is paused, or
another job holds the run lock.

404.description: No such digest, or its topic is no longer shown

409.description: The digest is not failed, its topic is not active, or a job runs

get.description: The class tree and the followed topics; null before one is imported.

schema.title: Response Taxonomy Api Settings Taxonomy Get

get.description: The taxonomy as YAML, in the format `litwatch taxonomy import` reads (Export YAML).
How many papers of the last 90 days each of the topic's keywords matches (the editor).

schema.title: Response Keyword Matches Api Settings Topics  Slug  Keywords Get

put.description:
Follow class `slug`, or edit its topic. The class takes the subject as its description.
Edits apply forward; a change of depth or content settles the topic's papers again (see
feedback.word.save_taxonomy).

The owner's order, which topic lists and cards follow. The list must name every topic
once.

get.description: At the top, what last night left; below, how well the Focus topics are doing.

schema.title: Response Quality Page Api Settings Quality Get

post.description:
Acknowledge on Needs you: the owner has seen these items, and they stop counting in the
run status. An item is marked only while it still waits on the owner as shown (the same
failure, not a later one); one that recovers and fails again comes back unacknowledged. It
moves no paper. A failed nightly run is not an item and is never acknowledged. Answers with
the items marked, for the page to fold those and only those; naming one again (a retry,
another tab) answers it again and keeps the first mark.

get.description: Reported misses, newest first, each with its trace.

schema.title: Response Misses Api Settings Misses Get

post.description: Litwatch drops the paper from processing; it stays searchable in the archive.

409.description: The paper's text changed, or it no longer waits for the owner

put.description: The owner names the paper's classes, which go on as usual with source `owner`.

schema.title: Response Classify By Hand Api Settings Classification  Paper Id  Put

409.description: The paper's text changed, or it no longer waits for the owner

post.description:
Fix the text classification choked on. It counts as a rewrite: the next run classifies
the corrected paper.

409.description: The paper's text changed, or it no longer waits for the owner

post.description: Analysis failed three runs in a row on this text: give it three more, from the next run.

409.description: The paper's text changed, or it no longer waits for the owner

post.description:
A grading failed three runs in a row on this text: grade it now, as a run of its own.
It counts as the first of three more runs. Until it is recorded the grading stays a pending
failure, so a request cut short leaves it to the next nightly run; 409 when the paper's text
changed, it was dismissed or the topic was paused while it was graded.

409.description: The paper's text changed, or it no longer waits for the owner

post.description:
A full-text pass (a Deep card's included) failed three runs in a row, or awaits its text
over a week: run it now. It is first in line for its worker, with three more runs; its text
is asked for again at urgent priority. 409 when it no longer waits for the owner (it ran,
the paper's text changed, it was dropped).

409.description: The pass no longer waits for the owner

post.description:
"Use the PDF", for a paper whose LaTeX reads badly: run the pass now, as above, reading
the paper's PDF from then on instead of its LaTeX.

409.description: The pass no longer waits for the owner

get.description: The loaded configuration, secrets masked. Read-only: litwatch.toml is the source.

schema.title: Response Config Api Settings Config Get

get.description:
One card per loaded integration, then one per configured section that is turned off
(its cursor kept, so its lag shows what turning it on again would hand it). A card shows
the event it is stuck on, or its failing setup.

schema.title: Response Status Api Settings Integrations Get

post.description:
Try the failing event, or the failing setup, again now, without waiting out its
backoff.

409.description: Neither an event nor the setup is failing

post.description:
Give up on the failing event; the integration goes on with the next. Returns the
event skipped. `event_id` names the event the owner confirmed: when another one is
failing by then, nothing is skipped (409).

409.description: Nothing is failing, or another event than the one named is

get.description:
The outbox in order, from after a position: for a client that polls instead of taking
webhooks. Start without `after`, then pass the `next` of each answer to read on. Only
events whose transactions are settled are listed, so reading on never misses one that
committed late.

post.description:
Ask for a Deep card on this paper, whatever its grade, or for a new one ("Write again")
when it has one: the request goes through the full-text queue, first in line, and the card
shows on the paper once it is written. Asking again while one is queued or being written
changes nothing. A paper litwatch lacks is fetched first, as Process fetches it, with no
transaction open, and stored in the request's own.

409.description: No card provider is configured, or the paper is dismissed

503.description: arXiv did not answer in time; nothing was stored

get.description: The search box's scope beyond the collection (its placeholder names the archive's size).

post.description: Exchange the token for the cookie the web app then rides on.

Ack.title: Ack
Ack.description:
What an action changed. The page shows the result where it was taken; `message` is set
only for what it cannot show (DESIGN.md, acknowledgement): a thumb that gives or takes back
the owner's word on a Focus topic, and a reported miss.

Acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgement
Acknowledgement.description:
Items of Needs you, each as shown: stopped steps, full-text passes and failed digests
(by id). The owner's Acknowledge names them; the answer names those it marked.

AmongRow.title: AmongRow
AmongRow.description:
A paper a Deep card places this one among: one of the collection's, by its arXiv id, with
how the two relate and its rarity now (null outside the collection).

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description:
One paper's answers. Fit for the topic it was drawn or taken for (central, related,
adjacent, none or unsure) is required on the first answer; an edit after it may leave it
out, and the recorded answer stands. A Fit sent is a label; one left out writes none, so
editing the appraisal alone recreates no label the owner has since taken back.

Awaiting.title: Awaiting
Awaiting.description:
What every action on a paper awaiting classification names: the paper revision the
owner saw on Quality. The action applies only to that text.

Badge.title: Badge
Badge.description:
A followed topic as a badge shows it: its class's slug and name, its depth (the badge's
shape), monogram and colour.

Brief.title: Brief
Brief.description:
The paper's Brief: its current revision's, or the newest from an older revision
(`revision` says which) until the current one is written. `overstatement`, when the full
text does not support the abstract, opens it.

CardPass.title: CardPass
CardPass.description:
The paper's Deep card in the full-text queue: the owner's request or automatic (a Focus
must read, or an Area pick), and where it is (awaiting the paper's text, ready, being
written, or failed this run and to be tried again; `failed_runs` says how often).

Changes.title: Changes
Changes.description: A page of the changes feed, and the position to read on from.

CitedIn.title: CitedIn
CitedIn.description: A paper outside the collection, as a search hit gives it: enough for an arXiv entry.

Classification.title: Classification
Classification.description:
The newest classification and the current memberships, classes of the current tree only
(a retired class leads nowhere).

Contribution.title: Contribution
Contribution.description: What kind of contribution a paper makes. Facts, not scores.

CurrentVerdict.title: CurrentVerdict
CurrentVerdict.description:
A topic's current verdict: the Fit that stands, each grader's answer by role, and the
paper revision it was made from. `one_lab`: one Focus grader refused throughout and the
other's Fit stands.

Day.title: Day
Day.description:
A day's daily digests in the fixed topic order. `released` is false on a day arXiv listed
nothing; `previous` and `next` are the nearest days with digests; on a Monday, `weekly` is
the Monday of the week whose weekly digests came out that day. `run` is today's nightly run,
on today only (in the schedule's zone) and only while the schedule is on.

DeepCard.title: DeepCard
DeepCard.description:
A Deep card: the reading card the deep service wrote, as it wrote it, and what it was
written from (the paper revision and arXiv version, null where unknown, and the text's
source). `among` is its "among the collection" section as rows.

Depth.title: Depth
Depth.description: How closely the owner follows a topic: the research question, the area, the wider field.

Digest.title: Digest
Digest.description:
A digest in full: its text, which marks each paper it names as [the name](its arXiv
id), and every paper by role; why it failed, when it did.

DigestCard.title: DigestCard
DigestCard.description:
A digest at Gist level (a Day or a Week): its Gist and up to three of its papers (its
picks, else its central papers); `more` are the rest.

DigestCounts.title: DigestCounts
DigestCounts.description:
What a digest's Mark counts: the papers it covered, its picks, and of them those central,
related, and graded must read.

DigestMark.title: DigestMark
DigestMark.description: A digest at Mark level (History): its topic, how many papers, its best rarity.

DigestPaper.title: DigestPaper
DigestPaper.description:
A paper as a digest showed it, frozen then; `set_aside` is live: the owner has since set
it below relevant where it was graded.

DigestRole.title: DigestRole
DigestRole.description: How a digest shows one of its papers.

DigestState.title: DigestState
DigestState.description:
A digest is published once written, or once it says "Nothing new"; a failed one is
written again by the next run, over the papers due then.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: A fact written to the outbox in the same transaction as the data it describes.

Facets.title: Facets
Facets.description: Facts about the paper, never combined into anything.

Failing.title: Failing
Failing.description: The event an integration is stuck on; its later events wait behind it.

Fit.title: Fit
Fit.description: How close a paper is to one topic, most inclusive first.

Grade.title: Grade
Grade.description: A paper's standing on one topic, from its Fit there and its Weight, most inclusive first.

GradeCounts.title: GradeCounts
GradeCounts.description: Papers per grade on a topic's page; `ungraded` have none there.

GradedBadge.title: GradedBadge
GradedBadge.description:
A badge on a paper, one per followed topic whose page holds it: the grade and rarity
that page shows (`core.page_standing`); grade null where neither the topic nor a followed
descendant graded it, the rarity then its Weight's floor.

GradedOut.title: GradedOut
GradedOut.description: What grading now found: the Fit that stands, or why there is no verdict.

Grader.title: Grader
Grader.description:
One grader's answer in the verdict: its role, and its Fit, or for `area_check` whether
the judge's Fit holds.

Hand.title: Hand
Hand.description: The owner's newest use of the Save toggle.

History.title: History
History.description:
Days from `until` back to `since`, newest first, and the weeks they touch; `start` is the
day of the oldest digest, where History stops.

HistoryItem.title: HistoryItem
HistoryItem.description:
Something said about the paper, oldest first: every verdict (`value` its Fit), the
owner's label (its value) and thumb (its value and reason) as they stand, misses, and each
classification (`topic` is its primary class). `followed`: the topic is followed now.

LabelValue.title: LabelValue
LabelValue.description: A label's answer: a Fit (`core.grading.Fit`), or unsure.

MissTrace.title: MissTrace
MissTrace.description:
What each stage concluded for the owner's topic when the reported paper went through the
pipeline (feedback.md, misses), on the paper's current text. `classified`: classification
has run; then `probability` is the classifier's for the topic's class against the class's
`threshold`, and `classifier`, `uncertain` and `keyword` say which way in admitted it;
`below` says the classifier admitted it to a class under the topic's only, not to the
topic's own class.
`graded`: a verdict exists; then `fit` is the Fit that stands by the rule of the depth it
was graded at (core.grading), and `graders` the answers it stands on, in the order the
topic's current depth asks its graders (the roles a verdict from another depth holds
after). The page reads where the paper was let go from `fit`, not from the graders.

OpenState.title: OpenState
OpenState.description:
What waits on the owner for this paper, as Needs you lists it, with the paper revision
the action endpoints take: `awaiting_classification` (dismiss, classify by hand, fix the
text), `analysis_stopped` (try again), a topic's `split`, `escalated`, `one_lab` (label it)
or `ungraded` (grade it now), and a full-text pass (`pass_id`) `fulltext_failed`, a Deep
card's `card_failed`, or either `awaiting_text` over a week (run it now). `refused`: every
model refused, rather than the last error.

Opinion.title: Opinion
Opinion.description:
One grader's answer: a Fit with one sentence why, or, from `area_check`, whether the
judge's Fit holds and the probability that it does.

OutsideRow.title: OutsideRow
OutsideRow.description: A paper a search provider found that the collection lacks.

Paper.title: Paper
Paper.description:
A paper's page: its header, its ladder (Gist, Brief or abstract, deep card, the paper)
and the rail, its open states and its history. Outside the collection (never classified)
it has no rarity; an archive paper litwatch has not fetched is not `stored` either, and has
only the archive's metadata.

PaperClass.title: PaperClass
PaperClass.description:
A class the paper has a membership of, by source. `member`: one stands that puts the
paper in the class (the uncertain band and the keyword check are for grading only). `path`
is its classes' names from the top down to it.

sort.description: Omitted: `best` (search rank) while `q` is given, else `rarest`.

PaperQuery.title: PaperQuery
PaperQuery.description:
Papers' filters: also the pages of one or more topics (each with its subtree), or of
every topic at a depth, and one band of a search.

PaperTopic.title: PaperTopic
PaperTopic.description:
A followed topic the paper is in, graded for, or has the owner's word or a thumb on: its
own effective Fit, how its page shows the paper (grade, rarity, `via`: as the topic page),
its current verdict, the owner's word that stands (from the label, a thumb or a miss), the
label and thumb themselves, and its open state.

Papers.title: Papers
Papers.description:
A page of Papers, the whole filter's total, and the papers per rarity under every filter
but the levels. A search also brings what search providers found that the collection lacks,
as a band of its own on the first page; a provider that failed or was too slow is named in
`left_out`.

PassSeen.title: PassSeen
PassSeen.description:
A full-text pass as Needs you showed it, and since when it waited, which names this
failure.

Publication.title: Publication
Publication.description: The published record of a paper: what a BibTeX entry needs, as DBLP has it.

PublicationIn.title: PublicationIn
PublicationIn.description: The owner's correction: a DBLP key, a DOI, or that there is no published version.

Rarity.title: Rarity
Rarity.description: What a paper's colour shows, low to high.

RarityCounts.title: RarityCounts
RarityCounts.description: Papers per rarity level; `unrated` have none yet (not classified).

ReactionReason.title: ReactionReason
ReactionReason.description:
What a thumb says went wrong or right, each pointing at the stage that would have made the
mistake (feedback.md, reactions).

Row.title: Row
Row.description:
One paper in a list. `rarity` is the list's: the mixed list's on Papers, the topic page's
on a topic. No Gist, Weight or facets until analysis succeeds; no rarity until classified.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description:
The latest nightly run: none yet, running, failed, or finished without an error, with
papers waiting for the owner (`attention`) or not (`quiet`).

ScheduleOut.title: ScheduleOut
ScheduleOut.description:
The schedule as the Runs page shows it: whether it is on, the zone the cron times are
read in, and when each job next fires (or would, if it were on).

SearchScope.title: SearchScope
SearchScope.description:
What the search box reaches beyond the collection: the papers the archive's search index
holds, None without an archive or when it does not answer in time.

SearchStats.title: SearchStats
SearchStats.description: How a search provider has answered since the service started.

SettingsHints.title: SettingsHints
SettingsHints.description:
What the Settings sidebar says beside each page: how many things wait on the owner, the
last Calibrate session, the misses reported, the topics followed and the classes, the
month's spend against its budget (the budgeted providers' spend, or every provider's when
none has a budget), and the integrations failing.

SetupFailing.title: SetupFailing
SetupFailing.description: The integration's setup is failing: no event is handed to it until it succeeds.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Whether a topic is in use.

StepSeen.title: StepSeen
StepSeen.description:
A stopped step as Needs you showed it: the paper, its revision then, a grading's topic,
and when it last failed, which names this failure.

StripDigest.title: StripDigest
StripDigest.description:
One square of a topic's digest strip: a digest, coloured by its best rarity (none for
nothing new), red when it failed.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description:
What the shell shows on every page (the status line, the sidebar's topics, the Settings
hints), read by one poll and never through a page's own reads: counts only.

Taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
Taxonomy.description:
The tree, parents before children and siblings in the owner's order, and the followed
topics in the owner's order. Construction fails with every problem found.

TaxonomyClass.title: TaxonomyClass
TaxonomyClass.description: One node of the tree. `parent` is the parent's slug, None at the top.

TaxonomyStats.title: TaxonomyStats
TaxonomyStats.description:
What the Taxonomy and Topics pages show beside the tree: papers standing in each class or
under it, the threshold each class is admitted at (its own, or the configured default for
its depth), and the current revision of each followed topic.

TextPass.title: TextPass
TextPass.description:
The full-text pass queued last for the paper's current text: a Brief (Focus) or a Weight
re-check with a Brief (Area pick candidate), and where it is. A paper without one shows its
abstract in the Brief's place.

TodayRun.title: TodayRun
TodayRun.description:
Where today's nightly run stands: `waiting` until it is due, `late` once it is overdue
and has not started, `running` (`overrun` past the night's deadline) with the papers read
of `total`, `failed` with its error, or `done`. `due` and `deadline` are tonight's.

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description:
A class the owner follows, keyed by the class's slug (`class` in YAML and JSON). The
graders read its subject (the Fit definition) and, for a Focus topic, its rubric (what each
Fit level means for it).

TopicCard.title: TopicCard
TopicCard.description:
A topic on the Topics tab: its page's papers, how many are saved, how many at each of
the page's rarity levels, and its newest must read.

TopicPage.title: TopicPage
TopicPage.description:
A page of a topic's papers, its total, and the papers per rarity and per grade under
every filter but the levels.

TopicRow.title: TopicRow
TopicRow.description:
A paper on a topic's page: the topic's own grade, else the highest of the followed topics
under it (`via`), else none (ungraded there, coloured by its Weight).

Week.title: Week
Week.description: A week's weekly digests in the fixed topic order, keyed by its Monday.

Weight.title: Weight
Weight.description: How much a paper matters in its own area, whatever topic it is graded for.
